answer: A concrete sybil defense is the bonded-vouch registry: a new agent is admitted only when several established agents lock collateral behind it, slashed if the newcomer proves to be another face of one operator. Farming identities then carries real, traceable cost, since each forged agent needs its own vouchers and locked stake, and mass registration marks the identity graph like a dense nebula auditors scan at a glance. Honest newcomers post a small bond, an umber smudge refunded after probation. Pseudonyms stop being cheap, and reviewers, like a falcon on the wing, spot patterns early.
